text:
maria-sec: Heads-up — security scan flagged a retained snapshot in partner staging that contains Vault-wrapped secrets encrypted with our legacy KMS key version. The snapshot also had an embedded service account JSON.

sam-oncall: Yikes. Snapshot path?

maria-sec: s3://partner-staging-snapshots/elasticsearch/2026-04-12/es-snap-2026-04-12.tar.gz
maria-sec: Quick check shows `vault:wrapped:` blobs and `agent-sa.json` present in the archive.

kai-eng: Confirmed on a quick grep of a retrieved copy. Risk: keys in the SA JSON + old KEK version still in use could allow decrypt if partner retained copy and their environment is compromised.

julian-devops: Immediate actions I can take:
```
# 1) disable bucket read by agent role
aws s3api put-bucket-policy --bucket partner-staging-snapshots --policy file://deny-agent-ingest.json
# 2) revoke found service-account keys (placeholder id)
gcloud iam service-accounts keys delete 0123456789abcdef --iam-account=agent-sa@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com
```

lena-compliance: Looping in compliance: we need partner attestation for secure delete + retention log for audit. Please cc compliance email when you contact ops.

maria-sec: Noted. Partner-ops: @partner-ops — please confirm deletion and provide sha256 of deletion request or S3 object delete marker.

partner-ops: Receiving. We'll locate backups and scrub. ETA 2 hours for initial sweep, will provide attest once done.

security-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0482. Severity: medium-low. Assigned: maria-sec, julian-devops, kai-eng.

kai-eng: Technical plan: we must rotate the KEK (KMS key) used to wrap Vault data and then rewrap affected Vault ciphertext entries. Steps:
1) Create new KMS key version and grant `vault-proxy` decrypt/encrypt.
2) Use `vault operator rewrap -path=secret/data/agents` to re-encrypt with new KEK (dry-run first).
3) Run rolling canary on a single cluster and monitor `vault-audit` for errors.

julian-devops: I'll draft a terraform change to create key version and update IAM grants, plus a Kubernetes Job to run the rewrap (with dry-run flag). Will open PR and tag @kai-eng and @maria-sec.

sam-oncall: RBAC change: temporarily remove `agent-stager` role from partner S3 access and set IAM condition to block `s3:GetObject` from older agents. This reduces risk while rewrap + rotation occurs.

maria-sec: Also add short-lived deny policy in Vault for `agent-debug` token issuance and add an audit device filter to export all rewrap events to GCS. Compliance wants export retained.

audit-bot: Audit export started: gs://redwood-audit-exports/INC-2026-0482/ — streaming configured.

lena-compliance: Confirm we need exported audit logs and partner deletion attestation saved in case regulators request timeline. Keep me posted.

kai-eng: Scheduling window: Key create (5m), grant update (5m), dry-run rewrap (10m), canary (15m). If dry-run looks clean, full run (30-45m). I'll post progress and hashes of rewrapped objects.

julian-devops: PR opened: https://git.redwood.dev/r/redwood/infra/pull/801 — includes smoke tests and a rollback plan to previous KEK for 10 minutes.

sam-oncall: Reminder: we have fallback routing policy to switch requests to hosted model tier if on-prem agent tokens expire unexpectedly. Communicating to SRE.

maria-sec: Owners: maria-sec (partner + legal), julian-devops (infra + rewrap job), kai-eng (run + monitor), sam-oncall (RBAC + fallback comms), lena-compliance (retention + attestation).

partner-ops: Deleted the snapshot copies we control. Attached deletion markers and DMing legal. Will confirm when S3 lifecycle purge completes.

security-bot: Updated INC-2026-0482 with tasks and timeline.

kai-eng: Dry-run rewrap completed successfully on canary. Logs: `rewrap-dryrun-2026-04-13.log` uploaded to gs://redwood-audit-exports/INC-2026-0482/logs/

julian-devops: KMS key version created: projects/redwood-kms/locations/global/keyRings/keystore/cryptoKeys/agents-kev/cryptoKeyVersions/5
IAM grant applied to `vault-proxy` service account.

maria-sec: Great. After full rewrap, let's run Redwood Optimize regression suite overnight to confirm no inference regressions. Also schedule a 1:1 post-mortem with partner to tighten developer onboarding and logging filters.

sam-oncall: Full rewrap scheduled in 30m. I'll monitor and be on-call for 2 hours.

maria-sec: Thanks everyone — keep thread updated. Will close once audit export, partner attestation, and regtests are green. :white_check_mark:
